name: privacy-scan
description: Pre-send gate for agent payloads: scans files or piped text for API keys, private key blocks, JWTs, credentialed connection strings, emails, phone numbers and .env-style content before anything is transmitted to a model provider or pasted into a prompt. Reports exact line:column findings with redaction suggestions and exits 20 when anything is found. Includes a --selftest mode whose built-in fixtures prove every pattern class fires.
